# truenas_tunable (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS tunable by variable name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `var` (String) Name of the tunable variable to look up.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number) Numeric tunable ID.
- `orig_value` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String)
